# The ERS97 rulebook's own count sheet for its model election (Electoral Reform Society, "How to
# conduct an election by the Single Transferable Vote", 3rd edition), as transcribed in pyRCV2's
# tests/data/ers97.csv (https://yingtongli.me/git/pyRCV2). Each stage: every candidate's votes,
# then the non-transferable votes (exhausted and lost to rounding together), and the votes required
# for election where the sheet gives it.
